layers.reference: Hit pause plus shake scaled to damage, contact flash, sparks
Heavier shake and a second, wider shock ring on a front contact; crunch and horn
Exaggerated score popup with a rising tick, sound on every action
Camera punch-in and body slam when the dummy drives into the car
Squash and stretch on a heavy dull thud, smoke off the stopped body
Longer shake, big ring and debris on big damage (Art of Screenshake)
Small dust puff, knockback with no reward
Dull bump with no burst, flash or number
Heavy shake, debris and wreck permanence over the write-off animation
Low boom under the crash so the write-off sounds heaviest
Speed lines, dust kicked backwards, small camera kick
Pass-by whoosh and speed lines along the car's travel; art of rally dust
Tighter pass earns longer streaks, a tiny shiver and a ping (no reward)
Stumble with arms flailing and a clatter; Juice It or Lose It body weight
